content: यन्त्रम् [यन्त्र्-अच्] .²1 That which restrains or fastens, any prop or support, a stay; as in गृहयन्त्र (see the quotation under this word.). .²2 A fetter, band, fastening, tie, thong, rein; छेदने चैव यन्त्राणाम् <ls>Ms. 8. 292</ls>. .²3 A surgical instrument, especially a blunt instrument (<ab>opp.</ab> शस्त्र). .²4 Any instrument or machine, an appliance, a contrivance, implement in general; कूपयन्त्र <ls>Mk. 10. 60</ls> ‘a machine for drawing up water from a well’; so तैल˚ (<ab>cf.</ab> यन्त्रं तिलपीडनकम् Chandu Paṇdita on <ls>N. 10. 6</ls>, <ls n="N.">22. 87</ls>); जल˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 A bolt, lock, key; यन्त्रैरुद्घाटयामास सोऽपश्यत् तत्र बालकम् <ls>Mb. 3. 309. 6</ls>. .²6 Restraint, force. .²7 An amulet, a mystical or astronomical diagram used as an amulet. .²8 A boring machine; दन्तौघयन्त्रोद्भवश्वभ्राली <ls>N. 22. 150</ls>.
